038329:         block = &builder->function->blocks[builder->current_block.value];

038337:             {
038338:                 return false;
038339:             }
038340:         }
038341:         else if (statement_expression_mode)
038342:         {
038343:             // This is the end of the nested GNU statement expression, not
038344:             // the end of its enclosing function.  The enclosing function's

038346:             // statement expression, and in a void function successful
038347:             // assertions must continue with the following statement.
038348:             return true;

038364:             if (zero.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_RETURN, &zero, 1, 0, 0, declaration_source))
038365:             {
038366:                 return false;
038367:             }
038368:         }
038369:         else
038370:         {
038371:             // Only the root body task has no continuation, so this is the end
038372:             // of a non-void function's body. Reaching the closing brace is
038373:             // undefined only if the caller uses the value (C 6.9.1p12), so
038374:             // this is not a refusal: terminate with unreachable, which is what
038375:             // Clang and GCC emit. sbase's dc ends `regname` with a call to its

038381:             block->terminated = true;
038382:         }
038383:     }
038384:     return true;

038387: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_body_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
038388: {
038389:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
038390:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
038391:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = machine->frames + machine->frame_count - 1;
038392:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_BODY && frame->as.body.state);
038393:     CIrLowerBodyState* state = frame->as.body.state;
038394:     bool stepping = true;
038395:     while (stepping)
038396:     {
038397:         bool success = c_ir_lower_body_advance(builder, state);
038398:         if (!state->yielded)
038399:         {
038400:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, success, state->result);
038401:             stepping = false;
038402:         }
038403:         else if (machine->failed)
038404:         {
038405:             stepping = false;
038406:         }
038407:         else
038408:         {
038409:             // Run the yielded child now, off the dispatch loop, when its kind
038410:             // is in the acyclic direct-run set; a completion loops the
038411:             // statement walk here without a dispatch round trip, and a
038412:             // suspension resumes through the loop unchanged.
038413:             u32 yield_mark = machine->frame_count - 1;
038414:             switch (machine->frames[yield_mark].kind)
038415:             {
038416:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION:
038417:                     c_ir_lower_expression_step(builder);
038418:                     break;
038419:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_BODY_ASSIGNMENT_STATEMENT:
038420:                     c_ir_lower_assignment_statement_step(builder);
038421:                     break;
038422:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_CONDITION:
038423:                     c_ir_lower_condition_step(builder);
038424:                     break;
038425:                 case C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_COMPOUND_LITERAL:
038426:                     c_ir_lower_compound_literal_step(builder, machine->frames + yield_mark);
038427:                     break;
038428:                 default:
038429:                     break;
038430:             }
038431:             stepping = machine->frame_count == yield_mark && !machine->failed;
038432:         }
038433:     }
038434: }

038436: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_lower_body(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CDeclaration declaration, bool statement_expression_mode,
038437:                                          IrValueId* statement_expression_result)
038438: {
038439:     TemporalArena temporary = arena_begin_temporal(builder->temporary_arena);
038440:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
038441:     bool outermost = machine->run_depth == 0;
038442:     if (outermost)
038443:     {
038444:         machine->root_frame_mark = machine->frame_count;
038445:         machine->scratch_mark = builder->scratch_arena->position;
038446:         machine->child_result = (CIrLowerFrameResult){
038447:             .value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID,
038448:         };
038449:         machine->failed = false;
038450:     }
038451:     u32 request_mark = machine->frame_count;
038452:     bool pushed = c_ir_lower_body_frame_push(builder, declaration, statement_expression_mode);
038453:     CIrLowerFrameResult lowered = {0};
038454:     if (pushed)
038455:     {
038456:         lowered = c_ir_lower_dispatch_run(builder, request_mark, outermost);
038457:     }
038458:     else if (outermost)
038459:     {
038460:         c_ir_lower_machine_unwind(builder);
038461:     }
038462:     scratch_end(temporary);
038463:     if (statement_expression_result)
038464:     {
038465:         *statement_expression_result = lowered.value;
038466:     }
038467:     return lowered.success;
038468: }
